Cultist.MarkDef.label: Identify the sign
Cultist.MarkDef.description: Bring back a lore book from the Wood, or ask an exotic trader for a survey transcript. Have a society member study a book, then place a copy near the altar and have the leader perform the first rite.

Cultist.MarkDef.label: Measure the light
Cultist.MarkDef.description: Complete Studies of Light in the research tab and have the leader record the result at the altar.

Cultist.MarkDef.label: Bring the sign home
Cultist.MarkDef.description: Dream through the Mansus and bring back a matching society influence. Have the leader offer an influence of at least 2 at the altar before it fades.

Cultist.MarkDef.label: Train a disciple
Cultist.MarkDef.description: Convert another colonist to the society using ideology conversion. Send them to the altar with a lore book to advance to disciple. With the disciple on the map, have the leader record the mark.

Cultist.MarkDef.label: Return the survey plate
Cultist.MarkDef.description: Have the leader trace the abandoned observatory at the altar and send a caravan to retrieve its engraved plate. Bring the plate home and equip the leader with society-aligned occult gear before recording the mark.

Cultist.MarkDef.label: Hold the threshold
Cultist.MarkDef.description: Set aside two physical lore books. Bring back a society-aligned influence of at least 10 from the deeper Mansus gates. Have the leader combine these inputs at the altar.
